text:
Aisha (CS): Quick ask — I’m compiling feature requests from last week’s onboarding + renewal calls. Can we centralize them and rank by renewal risk + customer impact? Need a short triage for AE playbooks.

Jenna (CSE): I have raw notes from 3 accounts: Helio (per-route billing toggle), Novaretail (bulk embedding export), Clearpath (onboarding template library). I can paste the snippets here.

Marco (PM): Helpful if each item has: 1) short description, 2) frequency (how many customers asked), 3) renewal risk (low/med/high), 4) rough dev effort. That'll speed prioritization.

Ravi (Eng): Quick engineering perspective — per-route billing toggle could be a config flag + tiny UI, perf risk depends on how billing is computed. Likely 2 sprints to ship minimal version.

Liam (CS Manager): Please mark anything that is actively blocking a renewal this quarter as `renewal blocker`. Those go highest priority for product/eng.

Aisha (CS): Got it. I'll create a short tracker row for each and tag renewals. Jenna, paste the verbatim asks when you have a sec.

Jenna (CSE): Pasting snippets below (raw):
```
Helio: "We need per-route billing toggle so we can turn on/off token billing per pipeline. Right now we get charged for dev spikes and it kills our POC budget. Renewal in 6 wks."
Novaretail: "Bulk export of embeddings (CSV or S3) — we need nightly dumps for our recommender. Current API is too slow for large catalogs."
Clearpath: "Onboarding templates for data connectors + sample prompts. New team needs a reproducible playbook."
```

feedback-bot: New product-feedback ticket created: PF-1234 — link: https://redwood.example.com/feedback/PF-1234 (auto-tag: onboarding, billing)

Marco (PM): I'll pick up triage on medium/high impact items. If you mark 'renewal blocker' I'll bump it in roadmap review.

Ravi (Eng): @Aisha / @Jenna — can you add per-route traffic numbers (requests/day) for Helio and Novaretail? need volume to estimate perf/cost tradeoffs.

Aisha (CS): Yep — exporting per-route counts from Console now, will attach to tracker row.

Jenna (CSE): Also heard a couple customers ask for better visibility on per-route costs in the UI (not just billing export). Might be a quick UX win.

Liam (CS Manager): Great. Plan: Aisha to create tracker rows + tag renewal blockers by EOD. Marco to review triage tomorrow. Ravi to estimate effort for flagged items after data from Console. Jenna to add any missing snippets.

Aisha (CS): On it — will ping here when tracker is live (:thumbsup:).

Marco (PM): Thanks team. If anyone wants to batch small UX fixes into a sprint, DM me and I’ll drop estimates.

Ravi (Eng): 👍

Jenna (CSE): tagging: @Liam for renewal flags I spotted (Helio = blocker).

Liam (CS Manager): Confirmed — Helio flagged as renewal blocker. Thanks.
